an7.20:1.1: Satt' imāni bhikkhave niddasavatthūni. Katamāni satta? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhāsamādāne tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca sikkhāsamādāne avigatapemo, dhammanisantiyā tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca dhammanisantiyā avigatapemo, icchāvinaye tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca icchāvinaye avigatapemo, paṭisallāne tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca paṭisallāne avigatapemo, viriyārambhe tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca viriyārambhe avigatapemo, satinepakke tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca satinepakke avigatapemo, diṭṭhipaṭivedhe tibbacchando hoti āyatiñ ca diṭṭhipaṭivedhe avigatapemo. Imāni kho bhikkhave satta niddasavatthūnī ti. Anusayavaggo dutiyo.
an7.20:2.0: Tass' udānaṃ: Dve anusayā kusalaṃ puggalaṃ udakūpamaṃ Aniccā dukkhā anattā ca nibbānaṃ niddasavatthūnī
